Title: Deduplicate repeated approval disclaimer text in chat responses.
Description: A repeated approval disclaimer paragraph appears in some multi-source chat responses. The duplication is reproducible across multiple prompts, so it should be deduplicated at the response assembly layer rather than treated as a one-off rendering glitch. Acceptance criteria: the same disclaimer is emitted once even when the agent reiterates the structured-write warning, the final answer stays readable, and the trace still preserves the underlying reason. Validation: rerun the multi-source prompts and confirm the response contains a single disclaimer paragraph.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: the 2026-05-24 multi-source fuzz passes reproduced the approval disclaimer twice in the rendered assistant response, even when the answer body updated correctly while the turn was still pending.
